text.en: Clients emphasize how eagerly their young dogs and rescue pets respond to training in the class setting. Owners describe puppies eagerly leading the way into the church gym facilities and enjoying structured socialization with other dogs, leaving sessions noticeably calmer and more confident in everyday routines.

Dog owners frequently praise trainer Jon for his reassuring presence, patience, and accessible teaching style during group classes and private sessions. Reviewers appreciate his humour and practical encouragement, noting that he effectively coaches handlers to understand canine perspectives and maintain consistent boundaries.

Reviewers report meaningful behavioural improvements in their dogs, ranging from solid recall cues and basic manners to reduced reactivity towards other dogs while on leash. Handlers highlight that the clear stepwise exercises translate into reliable responsiveness during neighborhood walks.

q.en: What puppy training options are offered?

a.en: Follow the Leader provides six-week puppy pupil courses emphasizing early socialization, foundational cues, and positive reinforcement.

q.en: Are private walk and train sessions available?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently book tailored one-on-one sessions to address leash reactivity and public outdoor manners.

q.en: Where do group puppy classes take place?

a.en: Classes are hosted in an indoor church gymnasium setting with dedicated floor space for controlled socialization.

q.en: Does the training use positive reinforcement?

a.en: The trainer relies on positive reinforcement, praise, and treat rewards to motivate dogs and build handler engagement.
